build_searcher_agent: build a Searcher agent to gather internal and external information for a given repository path
run_searcher_process: run the Searcher process method to parse reader responses and gather code information from AST nodes
parse_reader_response: parse a Reader agent XML response into a structured ParsedInfoRequest with internal and external requests
gather_internal_info: gather internal code information by resolving class, function, and method dependencies from the dependency graph
gather_external_info: gather external information by sending search queries to the Perplexity API and returning results
